description: Minimal capability for the main window. Only the event channel the UI subscribes to (sidecar://event): listen/unlisten. No window, app, path, menu, tray, resources, image or webview commands, and no shell, fs, http or dialog access from the webview; the folder picker is a native command (pick_folder). App commands (invoke) need no permission and are gated in Rust (ALLOWED_METHODS).
